name: naoto256-amt
description: Amnestic Trace — ephemeral replacement memory across a context boundary.

plugins.name: amt
plugins.description: Replaces a session's short-term working memory across compaction, and hands it to another session on request. A PreCompact hook starts a detached extraction over the journal since the last compaction; the next turn-start hook injects the result, because neither host can inject context from a compaction hook. Adds the /amt skill for cross-session handoff.
